structural_change: r8 (H.STA.BLK.14.6): r7 MAIN RTL unchanged (0 edges); MAIN hardened landing local: every kept 24-bit landing local (keep_hierarchy u_local) is its own placement cluster in a per-chunk box at its landing, in pin order. Read halves sit beside the hard-child / port pins their o bits feed (bit-exact pins from the child LEFs), rings beside the pins their i bits come from, soft-ended halves follow their same-region chain (tools/hbm_smh_r8/landing_boxes.py, results/arch/hbm_smh_r8_1022/landing_boxes_smh_rp8s_m.json). Fixes the r7 class: xs band had no room at the x-store bk1 (north) face, m band none at the merge top face, so GPL spread single locals across the band (u_lpl_9_r chunk82 -781.8 ps, u_lpl_27_r chunk13 -620, u_lpl_22_w -417 at CTS).
